How CPDSE applies it

alternate input → exercise → reflection; vary frame colour/format per block.

In our example designs Illustrative

  • FA516 course · Concrete Practice · 70 min

    Stress-test your project model

    Each group re-runs its own model with a scaffold split and a bootstrap, writes down how the conclusion changes, and saves the notebook so another group can re-run it.

  • SMPS20003U teachers' workshop · Concrete Practice · 25 min

    AI: good fit, poor fit, unsafe

    Teachers place eight example uses of AI by students on a three-zone floor map and argue over the borderline cases.
